name: staybnb
description: Staybnb - book stays in real time, or months ahead. Web app + API, mobile-ready.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @staybnb/api" "npm run dev -w @staybnb/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @staybnb/api && npm run build -w @staybnb/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @staybnb/api" "npm run start -w @staybnb/web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w @staybnb/api && npm run db:seed -w @staybnb/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @staybnb/api && npm run typecheck -w @staybnb/web
